description.value:
From Paper Moon King · Price: it only affects a creature that touches your paper.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: Gift (1 action): fold a paper into a small gift and hand, leave or toss it to a creature within 30 ft; taking or picking it up touches your paper. Slap (once per turn): your stand slaps a paper onto a creature it hit with a Strike this turn, which counts as touching your paper. A creature that touches your paper takes @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}) as the faces around it swim; on a failure it can't tell who struck it and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the start of your next turn.
  • 5: Surge: a creature that touched your paper this round sees every face melt into a stranger's: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[mental]] (@Check[will|against:stand|basic]{basic Will}); on a failure it can't recognize faces for 1 minute, and while this lasts it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1}.
  • 9: While a creature can't recognize faces, it can't tell allies from enemies: it can't Aid and doesn't benefit from its allies' auras or flanking.
  • 13: The surge affects every creature in a @Template[burst|distance:20]{20-ft burst} that touched your paper.
  • 17: Not recognizing faces lasts 1 hour.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
